intro: GTA 6's arsenal so far: what Rockstar has named, what its footage shows, and what only leaks suggest. Updated as the game is played.

statuses.named: Named by Rockstar: the name appears in Rockstar's own material
statuses.seen: Seen in official footage: shown in a trailer, screenshot or the Extended Look; the name comes from fans matching it to earlier GTA games
statuses.leak: Leak: only seen in leaked footage
statuses.ingame: In the game: checked in the released game
